title: Critical! catalogue, format 19
description: Shape of the catalogue artifact (ADR 0021): the spells and the PHB rule tables (step 9), the class and race tables (step 10, ADR 0030 step 23), the racial level limits (step 11, DMG Table 7), each priest spell's sphere codes (step 12, ADR 0030 steps 15 and 23), the equipment reference data and its two rule tables (step 13, ADR 0033 steps 21 to 23), the language catalogue and each race's language list (step 14, ADR 0032 step 4) the non-weapon proficiency descriptions (step 16, ADR 0037 step 19) Table 5's magical defence adjustment on the wisdom rows (step 17, ADR 0006 step 9), the class, group and race definitions with their feature and trait lists (step 18, ADR 0040 steps 1 to 4 and 7) and Table 5's spell immunities on the wisdom rows (step 19, ADR 0006 step 10). and, format 13 (step 20, ADR 0043), the psionicist: its rows in the shared tables, the psionic power progression, inherent potential and PSP recovery tables, the psionic disciplines and powers. Format 14 (step 21) drops the unread per-class sphere table: a class's spheres are its sphere_access feature. Format 15 (step 22) names a class's Constitution hit point column by the boolean bracketed_constitution. Format 16 (step 23) lets a psionic power say which slot it takes where its kind does not. Format 17 (step 24) lets a class say it is never one of a multi-class character's classes. Format 18 (step 25, ADR 0044 step 1) adds the psionic combat tables (attack_versus_defence, contact_cost, contact_modifiers) and lets a power's initial cost name its table or carry a plus amount on contact. The API reads format 18 only: formats 3 to 17 were each the same shape without the parts added later (or with the sphere table), and are retired (steps 16.5, 17.3, 18.3, 19.3, 20.3 21.2, 22.2, 23.2, 24.2 and 25.5). Shape only: the schema carries no book text.

format.description: Artifact format: 19 (ADR 0021 step 27: format 18 plus the top-level skill_sets, the shared skill tables renamed skill_race, skill_dexterity (rows keyed by skill) and skill_armor, without thief_skill_base, bard_skill_base and bard_armor_penalty, and the parameters of the weapon_specialization feature); format 18 was step 25's. An importer accepts exactly the formats it knows and refuses the rest.

version.description: Content version, UTC build date YYYY-MM-DD with an optional .N suffix for several builds on a day. Compared for equality only, never ordered.

classes.description: The class definitions (ADR 0040 step 1): one entry per class.

groups.description: The class groups (ADR 0040 steps 1.2 and 7): their THAC0 rows.

races.description: The race definitions (ADR 0040 step 2): one entry per race, the human included.

skill_sets.description: The skill sets (ADR 0040 step 12), in book order.

disciplines.description: The six psionic disciplines of the Complete Psionics Handbook (ADR 0043 step 8, ADR 0021 step 20).

powers.description: The psionic powers: sciences, devotions and the five defence and five attack modes (ADR 0043 step 8, ADR 0021 step 20), in book order.

localized.description: English is required; French is optional and the app falls back to English when it is absent. An absent language is omitted, never an empty string.

description.description: Text in the Markdown subset of ADR 0021 step 1: blocks separated by exactly one blank line; a block is a paragraph (one line, no hard wrap), a bullet list (lines starting with "- ") or a pipe table (lines starting and ending with "|"); no headings, no HTML, no leading or trailing whitespace. The pattern checks the block structure; the builder also checks table delimiter rows.

id.description: Stable key, never changes once published (spellbook, spell effects, slots and undo history reference it). The builder keeps it in a published-id ledger (ADR 0021 step 3).

school.description: Raw school text as the book prints it; may hold several, e.g. "Alteration, Evocation".

sphere.description: Priest spells only (raw text, may hold several spheres). Omitted for Wizard spells.

spheres.description: Format 6, priest spells only: the spell's spheres as language-neutral codes (e.g. all, combat, elemental_fire, thought), one per sphere of the raw sphere text, Elemental as its subsphere codes (ADR 0030 step 23). The engine reads these, never the raw text.

source.description: Provenance of the English text, 2 to 8 upper-case characters: a book code (PHB, TOM) or WEB for text of the original web scrape that no book has been matched to.

rule_tables.description: The rule tables the engine looks values up in (ADR 0021 steps 9 and 10): numbers and language-neutral codes only, the columns the engine reads, rows in ascending order. Format 3 carries the first four tables only, format 4 every table but race_level_limits, format 5 every table but sphere_access (which formats 6 to 13 carried and format 14 dropped), format 6 every table but weapon_vs_armor and initiative_item, format 7 every table. Contiguity, overlap, level order, increasing XP and completeness of the code combinations cannot be expressed here: the builder and the importer check them. Format 13 added the psionicist's rows to saving_throws and race_level_limits and the tables psionicist_powers, inherent_potential and psp_recovery; format 14 has no sphere_access table.

weapon_vs_armor.description: Format 7: PHB Table 52 (optional rule), the modifier of each armour type (a row code of the equipment) against each damage type (s slashing, p piercing, b bludgeoning); exactly one row per armour row (ADR 0033 steps 19 and 21). The engine reads the damage type of the attack against the target's armour row.

race_languages.description: Format 8: each race's language list (PHB chapter 2, the Languages paragraph of each race, ADR 0032 step 4): one row per race and language of its list, native marking the race's own language (exactly one per race; Common for a human and a half-elf). The language is a code of the artifact's languages.

initiative_item.description: Format 7: PHB Table 56 (optional rule), the initiative modifier of a magic item by its magic kind (ADR 0033 steps 15 and 21); one row per kind. A scroll has no modifier: the spell's casting time counts, so its row carries none.

strength_row.description: PHB Table 1: a range of Strength scores, and for 18 a range of the 18/xx percentile.

exc_min.description: 18/xx percentile, 100 = 18/00; 0 with exc_max 0 = no exceptional part.

dexterity_row.description: PHB Table 2: a range of Dexterity scores.

defensive.description: Defensive adjustment to AC (negative improves it).

bard_spells_row.description: PHB Table 32: the spells a bard of that level casts per day.

per_spell_level.description: Spells per day of spell levels 1 to 6.

bard_experience_row.description: PHB Table 25, Thief/Bard column: the XP that reaches the level.

experience_row.description: PHB Tables 14 (Fighter), 20 (Mage), 23 (Cleric), 25 (Thief/Bard): the XP that reaches the level, per class. The psionicist's column is Complete Psionics Handbook Table 2.

hit_dice_row.description: PHB Tables 14, 20, 23, 25 (Hit Dice column): the group's hit die, the last level that rolls it, and the fixed hit points gained per level after it.

constitution_row.description: PHB Table 3: hit point adjustment per die (every class, and the warriors' own), and the value a low die counts as (0 = none).

intelligence_row.description: PHB Table 4: highest spell level (0 = none), chance to learn a spell in percent, maximum spells per level (absent = no maximum).

wisdom_row.description: PHB Table 5: the bonus spells this score adds (spell levels, not cumulative), the chance of spell failure in percent the magical defence adjustment (a signed bonus on saving throws against magic that attacks the mind, ADR 0006 step 9) and the spell immunities (the catalogue ids of the spells the row adds, not cumulative: a score is immune to its row's and every lower row's, ADR 0006 step 10).

con_save_bonus_row.description: PHB Table 9: saving throw bonus by Constitution.

race_requirement_row.description: PHB Table 7: the score range a race allows for an ability (before the racial adjustments).

race_adjustment_row.description: PHB Table 8: a race's ability adjustment (abilities not listed: 0).

race_level_limit_row.description: DMG Table 7 and, for the psionicist, CPsiH Table 1: the highest level a race reaches in a class: max_level 1 to 20, 0 = the race cannot belong to the class (the book's dash), absent = no racial limit (the book's U). Humans have no row (no limit in any class).

thac0_row.description: PHB Table 53: THAC0 per group at the level.

saving_throw_row.description: PHB Table 60: the five save targets of a group over a level band (levels 1 to 20).

level_rate_row.description: PHB Table 15: warrior melee attacks per round over a level band, as attacks per rounds.

specialist_attack_row.description: PHB Table 35: a specialist's attacks per round with a weapon over a level band.

rate_of_fire_row.description: PHB Table 45 (ROF): a missile weapon type's rate of fire, as attacks per rounds.

wizard_spells_row.description: PHB Table 21: the spells a wizard of that level memorizes, spell levels 1 to 9.

priest_spells_row.description: PHB Table 24: the spells a priest of that level prays for, spell levels 1 to 7.

priest_spell_wisdom_row.description: PHB Table 24's notes: the Wisdom a priest needs to use spells of that level.

skill_race_row.description: PHB Table 27: a race's adjustment to a thieving skill, in percentage points.

skill_dexterity_row.description: PHB Table 28 as rows keyed by skill: a Dexterity band's adjustment to one skill, in percentage points (a skill with no row at a score adjusts by 0).

skill_armor_row.description: PHB Table 29: an armour's adjustment to a thieving skill, in percentage points (leather is the baseline, 0).

backstab_row.description: PHB Table 30: backstab damage multiplier over a level band.

turning_row.description: PHB Table 61: an undead type (and its Hit Dice: hd_max absent = and more, both absent = by type only) and the cell for each priest level 1 to 20.

turning_cell.description: Either roll (success on a d20 at or above it) or outcome (no die: turned, destroyed, destroyed and 2d4 more, or cannot turn).

damage_expr.description: A damage as printed: dice NdM, a flat number, with an optional flat bonus (1d6+1, 1d3-1, 1).

equipment.description: Format 7: the equipment reference data (ADR 0033 steps 21 to 23, ADR 0021 step 13): the weapons, ammunition, body armour and shields a player picks from. Numbers and codes only, names as language maps; no book text. A character's piece copies a row and keeps its code, so the importer never keeps a row for a character.

languages.description: Format 8: the language catalogue (ADR 0032 step 4): the languages of the PHB racial lists plus Common, and any campaign language. Codes are language-neutral (ADR 0023); the names are language maps.

proficiency_descriptions.description: Format 9: the description of each non-weapon proficiency of ADR 0037 step 2's catalogue (ADR 0021 step 16): exactly 65 rows, one per proficiency id, in English and French, each in step 1's Markdown subset. The name stays an i18n key by id and the figures stay in seeds/proficiencies.json, so a row carries nothing else. That every catalogue id has a row is the builder's and the importer's check (the ids are data, not schema).

description.description: Both languages are required (spells require English only): a proficiency pop-up has a text in either language.

weapon_row.description: PHB Table 44 weapon row. A launcher (fires) has a speed but no damage: its ammunition's rows carry the dice. damage_sm / damage_l go together.

fires.description: A launcher's ammunition kinds (a blowgun fires two).

ammunition_row.description: An ammunition row of PHB Table 44 (arrow, quarrel, bullet, stone, needle, dart).

armour_row.description: A body armour (PHB Table 44, Table 46, with elven chain mail, DMG): base_ac is Table 46 without a shield; skill_column the Table 29 column (none_allowed: an armour a thief or bard may not wear); armor_row the Table 52 row.

shield_row.description: A shield (PHB p.75-76): its AC bonus against melee and against missiles.

class_code.description: A class id: language-neutral, the value characters.class stores.

group_code.description: A class group id (ADR 0040 step 1.2): data like a class id.

table_name.description: The key of a rule table of this artifact.

xp_threshold_row.description: The experience points a class needs to reach the level (PHB Tables 14, 20, 23, 25).

ability_minimum_row.description: PHB Table 13: the least score of an ability the class needs. An ability with no minimum has no row.

class_weapon_ref.description: A weapon a class may wield beyond its weapon types, by catalogue code with its weapon type.

class_equipment.description: What the class may wear and wield: the one source of ADR 0033 step 20's warnings and of the weapon proficiency types of ADR 0037 step 7 (ADR 0040 step 1.6).

armour.description: The `skill_column` values of the equipment armour rows the class may wear (`none` = no armour worn); absent = any.

shields.description: Whether the class may use a shield.

weapon_types.description: The weapon types the class may wield; with `weapons` the whole list; absent with no `weapons` = any (ADR 0033 step 20, ADR 0037 step 7).

blunt_only.description: The class wields bludgeoning weapons only.

class_hit_dice.description: PHB Tables 14, 20, 23, 25 (Hit Dice column) and Table 3's column (ADR 0040 step 1.8).

dice_levels.description: The last level that rolls the die.

after.description: The fixed hit points gained per level after it.

bracketed_constitution.description: Whether the class takes the parenthesised hit point adjustment of PHB Table 3's Constitution column (true) or the plain one (false).

rogue_budget.description: Skill points to spend: at the first level and at each level after; the most in one skill likewise (0 = no limit).

rogue_armour.description: A body armour a skill set can be worn with, found by the armour row's `skill_column` of the equipment (`code`; `none` = no armour worn). The list must carry an entry for every `skill_column` value of the equipment, so a worn armour always resolves (none_allowed, an armour the class may not wear, is entered with the worst column).

code.description: The `skill_column` of the equipment armour rows this entry covers (leather, padded_studded, elven_chain, metal, none_allowed), or `none`.

column.description: The `armor` row code of the `thief_skill_armor` rule table (PHB Table 29) read; absent for leather, the baseline (adds nothing).

extra.description: An additional adjustment, in percent points (the bard's penalty in non-elven chain mail).

class_feature.description: A class feature (ADR 0040 step 3): a kind from the closed list with the parameters that kind takes. A new mechanic is a new kind, never a branch on a class id.

from_level.description: The class level the feature starts at; absent = 1.

class_def.description: A class definition (ADR 0040 step 1, ADR 0021 step 18). Cross references (the group's rows, the tables named, a kind once per class) are checked by the builder and the importer.

alignments.description: The alignments the class allows; absent = any.

multiclass.description: Format 17 (ADR 0021 step 24, ADR 0042 step 2.1): whether the class may be one of a multi-class character's classes; absent = true. False on the bard (no race's multi-class combination names it).

spell_progression.description: The key of the rule table of the slots per level; absent = no spells (ADR 0040 step 1.9).

nonweapon_groups.description: The proficiency groups the class learns at the listed cost (PHB Table 38).

group_def.description: A class group (ADR 0040 steps 1.2 and 7): its THAC0 by level, PHB Table 53, as rows keyed by group.

race_identity.description: PHB Tables 10 and 11 as the creation rolls of ADR 0032 step 5 read them (inches, pounds, years; the app converts).

height.description: PHB Table 10: base height in inches by sex, and the modifier dice.

weight.description: PHB Table 10: base weight in pounds by sex, and the modifier dice.

start_age.description: PHB Table 11: the starting age in years.

max_age.description: PHB Table 11: the maximum age range, base plus dice, in years.

race_trait.description: A race trait (ADR 0040 step 4): a kind from the closed list with its parameters.

race_def.description: A race definition (ADR 0040 step 2, ADR 0021 step 18): Table 7 requirements and Table 8 adjustments (none for the human), the identity rows, the typed traits. The thief skill adjustments, the level limits and the languages stay tables keyed by race.

psionicist_powers_row.description: CPsiH Table 4: the cumulative disciplines, sciences, devotions and defence modes a psionicist knows at the level (ADR 0043 step 6).

inherent_potential_row.description: CPsiH Table 5: the base PSP score at the ability score, and the modifier the score adds (ADR 0043 step 4).

attack_versus_defence_row.description: CPsiH Table 14 (ADR 0044 step 1.1): the modifier to the attacker's power score when the attack mode meets the defence mode. attack is an attack_mode power id, defence a defence_mode power id; one row per pair of the catalogue's modes, which the builder and the importer check.

contact_cost_row.description: CPsiH Table 29 (ADR 0044 step 1.2): the contact power's initial cost by the target's level or hit dice, min_level to max_level. The bands are contiguous from level 1, which the builder and the importer check; a level past the last band has no cost.

contact_modifier_row.description: CPsiH Tables 30 and 31 and the contact power's resistance (ADR 0044 step 1.3): a modifier to the contact power's score. kind distance (Table 30), life_order (Table 31) or resistance (a nonpsionicist resisting); code a language-neutral code the web words. Each code once, which the builder and the importer check.

psp_recovery_row.description: CPsiH Table 6: the PSPs recovered per hour of the activity (ADR 0043 step 6).

power_code.description: A psionic power id: the English name's slug, never changed (the ledger of the books repository).

power.description: A psionic power (CPsiH chapters 3 to 8; ADR 0043 step 8). score is absent where the book gives a formula in the text (Intensify, Splice). initial_cost and a maintenance cost are a number, `variable` (the text or a table gives it) or, for the initial cost, `contact`. maintenance is absent where the power cannot be maintained; its period is in rounds. min_level is a prerequisite stated as a psionicist level. Cross references (discipline, prerequisites) are checked by the builder and the importer.

slot.description: Format 16 (ADR 0021 step 23): the slot the power's pick takes where its kind does not say it (an attack mode takes a devotion's slot, except Psionic Blast, a science). Absent where the kind says it.

initial_cost.description: A number, or `variable` (the text gives it), or `contact` (contact made first, ADR 0044 step 10); format 18 (ADR 0021 step 25): or {table} (a rule table gives it: the contact power's contact_cost), or {kind: contact, plus} (contact made first, then the plus amount: Switch Personality).

skill_set.description: A set of skills a class's rogue_skills feature names (ADR 0040 step 12): the skills with their base percentages (PHB Table 26 for the thief's set, 33 for the bard's) and the least percentage a skill of the set is used at.

id.description: Language-neutral; what rogue_skills.set and characters.skill_sets name.

skill_set_skill.description: A skill of a set: its base percentage; armour_free marks a skill a multi-class character in body armour its class may not wear still uses (ADR 0042 step 16.3). Absent = false.

feature_params_weapon_specialization.description: The specialization's costs and Table 35 columns (ADR 0040 step 13).
